newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus jails two Turks for illegal entry.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus jails two Turks for illegal entry.

text.p: Two mainland Turks were jailed for two months each in Cyprus on Wednesday for entering the island through an illegal port of entry, police said.
Police identified them as waiter Minir Tok, 22, and baker Selahallin Babrak, 34. Their home towns were not immediately known.

Police said they admitted entering Cyprus through Kyrenia, a northern coastal town authorities have declared an illegal point of entry since 1974, when Turkish forces invaded Cyprus in response to a brief Greek Cypriot coup engineered by the military then ruling Greece.
They were arrested in the southeastern resort of Paralimni on July 9, close to the ceasefire line splitting the island.
